statement: Co-packaged optics adoption is set to ramp from ~0.5% of AI optical modules in 2026 to ~35% by 2030, with NVIDIA Spectrum-X Photonics (up to 409.6 Tb/s) due 2H 2026 and Quantum-X shipping early 2026.
why: A steep CPO adoption curve plus shipping high-radix photonic switches expands networking-fabric bandwidth supply for AI clusters.

impact.mechanism: Rising CPO penetration and multi-hundred-Tb/s photonic platforms add scalable interconnect capacity for GPU clusters.

evidence.excerpt: CPO penetration in AI data centers 'roughly 0.5% of optical modules in AI' (2026), projected 'to reach 35% by 2030'.

confidence.basis: Single secondary technical guide, older than the recency window.
